description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1) If the word of God says the soul that sinneth is the soul that shall die, and the son shall not bear the iniquity of the father neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son; why then was not only the entire human race cursed on account of one man's sin but why was nature cursed as well?
.
2) Hello. I’ve been reading the book of Leviticus and from the beginning, I was getting the idea of what ceremonial laws are but when I reached chapter 19. It’s more like the general law, I don’t know if those laws are still abiding or not, because some of them are necessary to understand the 10 commandments in detail but some of them are making me wonder which leads me to ask this question: how are we to filter some of these laws which I think are (somewhat moral laws or maybe ceremonial I’m not sure)? We find about tattoos and many of us take this and we believe tattoos are not okay for a Christian but in the same verse we find about men’s haircuts and beards..should it also be considered? Because if not then why are we only picking on the part of the verse and leaving the other or is there a way of figuring out the context and knowing which ones still apply? What are ceremonial laws really? Because I think some of them are helpful but I’m not so sure and I don’t want to only pick out what’s okay with me and I don’t want to be an extremist too. 
.
3) Would like for you to explain where all the different ethnic groups came from.  Where and when did people from China and Japan come to be.  Where and when did Africans come to be.  Where and when did Caucasians come to be according to the Bible.  Noah and his sons started to re-populate the earth after the flood.  How did 8 people manage to produce so many different types of people?  
.
.
